explanation: The Balister–Győri–Schelp conjecture (Conjecture 1 in arXiv:2607.08630): a zero-sum list of 2^{s−1} nonzero vectors in F₂^s has a "Hadamard pair solution", i.e. F₂^s can be partitioned into pairs {h_{2i}, h_{2i+1}} with h_{2i} + h_{2i+1} = v_i. The equivalence e : Fin(2^{s−1}) × Fin 2 ≃ F₂^s encodes exactly such a partition. Requiring s ≥ 2 is harmless, since s = 1 is vacuous. The statement is faithful and open.
